comparison.objective: Remove a drill battery by depressing both release buttons and sliding the pack off.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate simultaneous bilateral latch actuation with constrained linear extraction of an intact battery.
comparison.success_condition: Both releases must be actuated and the battery must slide fully free without forcing, dropping, or damaging the drill interface.
comparison.reason: This combines latch release with intact-component sliding. The candidate instead aligns a separate mandrel and uses impact to irreversibly fracture sacrificial tangs while retaining the surrounding coils and recovering fragments.
